featured_title: Marsh Landing Estero FL: Who Has to Approve Your Purchase Before You Close? 2026
featured_excerpt: If you are buying a townhouse condominium or a villa in Marsh Landing, two separate boards have to approve you in writing, not one. The master application is due at least 30 days before your expected closing date, and buyers of the 163 single-family homes deal with the master association only.
others_caption: Also this week: whether your buyer can actually insure your home, Cascades at Estero after its builder went bankrupt, what Florida Amendment 3 means for Southwest Florida homeowners, Grandezza vs Wildcat Run on which club sets your dues, Tidewater by Del Webb's occupancy rules, how to get a home removed from a Lee County flood zone, and Naples school attendance zones.
